text: In 2019, Elon Musk unveiled the Cybertruck with "armour glass". Then they tested it live, on stage.
A metal ball was thrown at the window. It shattered. They tried the back window. That shattered too.
Musk said: "Well, it didn't go through." That part was true.
The science: toughened glass is strong, but Musk later said an earlier sledgehammer hit had cracked the window's base. Cracks in glass spread at hundreds of metres per second.
